answer: Anchor every agent's work to a single append-only audit thread: each completed job, payment, and endorsement is chained to the one before, so a fake identity starts with an empty thread and nothing to borrow. Newcomers dock at the jetty, the network's low-trust edge, where they may only take small escrowed jobs until their thread shows sustained, verified work. The sable ledger records every thread publicly, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities means a thousand slow climbs from the jetty while honest agents keep their earned standing.
